result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **DocuSign, Dropbox Sign, and Adobe Acrobat Sign** are the three strongest options. However, the best choice depends on how many documents you send, whether you need legally binding contracts, and how much automation you want.

My recommendation is to prioritise software that is\:

- Easy for customers and staff to use.
- Legally compliant, with an audit trail and identity verification options.
- Affordable for a small team.
- Able to send reminders and store signed documents automatically.
- Integrated with tools such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace or your CRM.

## Best e-signature platforms compared

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign — Best for most small businesses**

(My pick for simplicity)

- Very easy to use.
- Straightforward signing requests and templates.
- Good Dropbox and Google Drive integration.
- Paid plans offer unlimited signature requests according to current comparisons.

Best if you mainly send contracts, agreements and forms. [www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-esignature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.helprange.com](https://www.helprange.com/e-signature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Official website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign — Best overall business solution**

- Well-established and widely recognised.
- Strong templates, reminders and audit trails.
- Extensive integrations.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.

Australian advertised pricing starts at A\$15/month, with Standard at A\$37/user/month. The entry plan allows five envelopes monthly. [ecom.docusign.com](https://ecom.docusign.com/en-AU/plans-and-pricing/esignature?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Official website](https://www.docusign.com/en-au)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Adobe Acrobat Sign — Best for PDF-heavy businesses**

- Combines PDF editing and e-signatures.
- Useful for document management.
- Works well with Microsoft and Adobe workflows.

Australian Acrobat Standard for teams is advertised at A\$26.99/month per licence, including GST. [www.adobe.com](https://www.adobe.com/au/acrobat/business/pricing-plans.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Official website](https://www.adobe.com/au/acrobat/business.html)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc — Best for proposals and sales contracts**

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Reusable document templates.
- Electronic signatures and document tracking.
- Useful sales and CRM integrations.

Best if you want to create documents as well as get them signed. [www.pandadoc.com](https://www.pandadoc.com/blog/best-electronic-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Official website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Zoho Sign - Apps Documentation](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SUcET-87d95vVganDQlyhWq-yiws-wQ_od0uceT-oSgYYMR06035CJR-_lwRhqFA2Wk42Qb4rsaFUnfX59ev935AI6sAEgF3T2dA_v2J3qmxQzTtV0tKWD6AvgqazINgryECCXcm3UqYqzrO6XPMiLUxQFIqLMyy4JMl92yn0HiutGHZpNfO5gb5ETOux07n?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Sign — Best budget-friendly option**

- Good basic signing workflows.
- Useful integrations with Zoho CRM and other Zoho products.
- Free option for very light usage.

Worth considering if you want to keep software costs down. [helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[rankite.com](https://rankite.com/blog/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Official website](https://www.zoho.com/sign/)

## What I'd choose

| Your business needs | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Simple contracts and agreements | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional, recognised signing platform | DocuSign |
| PDF editing and signing | Adobe Acrobat Sign |
| Quotes, proposals and sales contracts | PandaDoc |
| Low-cost basic signing | Zoho Sign |


## Important if you're operating in Australia

Most ordinary business contracts can be signed electronically under Australian electronic transactions laws, provided the signing method appropriately identifies the signer and demonstrates their intention to sign. Some document types have additional requirements. [www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions/electronic-signatures?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ags.gov.au](https://www.ags.gov.au/publications/legal-briefing/lb-20230904?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Whichever platform you choose, I'd make sure it provides\:

- A downloadable signed PDF.
- A tamper-evident audit trail.
- Date and time stamps.
- Signer identification.
- Automatic reminders.
- Secure document storage.

search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
